approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with ReXGlue; native Linux AppImage with themed launcher, Windows build from CI
notes: Linux v1.1.1 released: full-speed 60 fps fights (runtime performance and frame-pacing fixes), no /dev/shm leaks on crashes. Windows build is a test pre-release, not yet confirmed on native hardware. Offline play only - no online versus. DLC fighters are not included in the base package.
